title: B1.11 near-saturated KSATEXM constitutive preservation

trigger.finding: Current typed default-MvG provider reproduces theta but misses the legacy near-saturated KSATEXM conductivity extension. Enabling only the exact B1.11 formula makes all six frozen solver heads/thetas/ponding/top/bottom fluxes exactly equal.

legacy_authority.formula: if fluseksatexm(node) AND relsat > relsatthr(node) AND swmacro==0: term=(relsat-relsatthr)/(1-relsatthr); K=term*ksatexm+(1-term)*ksatthr
legacy_authority.activation: fluseksatexm(node) is set when cofgen(10,node) > cofgen(3,node)

implementation_contract.default_behavior: KSATEXM extension remains disabled unless explicitly requested; all previously admitted provider routes therefore retain exact postimages/semantics.
implementation_contract.enabled_behavior: Per-node legacy activation is still cofgen(10)>cofgen(3); no new parameterization or fitted physics.
implementation_contract.carrier: Add one explicit boolean capability flag to typed B1.10 hydraulic parameters / serialized FMR physical parameters.

pass_conditions: default-disabled provider preserves existing K behavior
enabled positive-head Hupsel node returns exact ksatexm
enabled near-saturated interpolation matches frozen B1.11 oracle
below-threshold enabled route equals prior default MvG
all six M1-C3 frozen HeadCalc solver snapshots replay exactly for h/theta/pond/qtop/qbot
independent qualification with no production mutation
